description_sq:
Ne zonen mes Doganes se Tiranes dhe Aeroportit SHESIM objekt multifuknsional.
Objekti komercial Magazine+Zyra vetem 2 km nga Aeroporti dhe Dogana e Tiranes dhe 3km nga autostrada Tirane-Durres.
Ka nje siperfaqje trualli prej 13,500m2 dhe nje siperfaqje ndertimi 6870m2 i cili organizohet ne 1 objekt te vetem me hyrje dalje nga te gjitha anet.
Magazina me siperfaqje 6200m2 e organizuar ne open space, lartesi 11m, me porta te medha ku mund te futeten kamionat brenda, po ashtu ne pjesen ballore te objektit eshte hapesira per showroom dhe zyra me siperfaqje 670m2.
Per ndertimin e objektit jane perdorur materiale te nje cilesie te larte dhe te gjitha ne perputhje me standartet EU. Objekti eshte i pajisur me linje energjie 3 fazore, hidrante per mbrojtjen nga zjarri, sistemin e furnizimit dhe menaxhimit te ujit. Ndodhet prane rruges kryesore me akses direkt per te gjitha llojet e mjeteve te transportit.
Per me teper informacion ose vizite ne kete prone mos hezitoni te kontaktoni.
description_en: In the area between the Customs of Tirana and the Airport SHESIM multifunctional building. The commercial facility Magazine+Office is only 2 km from the Airport and Customs of Tirana and 3 km from the Tirana-Durres highway. It has a land area of ​​13,500m2 and a construction area of ​​6870m2, which is organized in 1 single building with entrance and exit from all sides. Warehouse with an area of ​​6200m2 organized in open space, height 11m, with large gates where trucks can enter, also in the front part of the building there is space for a showroom and office with an area of ​​670m2. High quality materials were used for the construction of the building, all in compliance with EU standards. The facility is equipped with a 3-phase power line, hydrant for fire protection, water supply and management system. It is located near the main road with direct access to all types of transport. For more information or a visit to this property, do not hesitate to contact us.
